name: C11_PI_TWO_VERTEX_SEPARATOR_COMPOSITION_GATE_V1

definition: C is a connected authoritative C11 PI residual after only frozen deterministic propagation/normalization.
C is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron.
C is NOT CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_READY under the frozen one-vertex composition definition.
domain.rationale: The gate asks whether every residual that survives the entire current one-vertex closure library factors through some genuine two-vertex graph separator.

CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_READY.definition: A connected component D is CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_READY iff there exists r in Cut(D) such that for every kappa in L_D(r), after fixing r=kappa and frozen propagation every surviving connected component is in BASE0.
CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_READY.discovery: Enumerate graph-only every articulation r and every kappa in its exact list.
CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_READY.polynomiality: At most |V(D)| articulation candidates, at most four colors per candidate, and only polynomial BASE0 calls.

closure_library.CLOSED_COMPONENT: A surviving component is closed iff it is in BASE0 or CUT_VERTEX_COMPOSITION_READY.

two_separator_discovery.Sep2_C: The complete graph-only set of unordered two-vertex sets S={u,v} such that C-S has at least two connected components.
two_separator_discovery.algorithm: Enumerate all O(n^2) unordered vertex pairs; delete the pair and compute connected components.

boundary_states.Col_L_CS: All assignments sigma:S->[4] that respect the exact lists of both separator vertices and are proper on C[S].

empty_state_semantics.rule: If Col_L(C[S]) is empty, S is an EMPTY_BOUNDARY_GOOD_SEPARATOR.
empty_state_semantics.reason: Any global coloring of C would restrict to a proper list-respecting coloring of C[S]; therefore no global coloring exists.
empty_state_semantics.consequence: Such an S satisfies GOOD_2(C) and immediately blocks strong R2 for C.

closed_definition.formula: Closed(C,S,sigma) iff after fixing sigma and applying only frozen deterministic propagation, the branch is CONTRADICTION or every surviving connected component D is a CLOSED_COMPONENT.
component_partition_receipt: components partition all remaining undecided vertices
no original edge joins different components
all boundary-color restrictions from sigma are reflected in exact propagated lists

good_separator_definition.GOOD_SEPARATOR: GOOD_SEP2(C,S) iff S in Sep2(C) and [Col_L(C[S])=empty OR for every sigma in Col_L(C[S]): Closed(C,S,sigma)].

exact_quantifier_binding.R1_formula: for every authoritative C in domain, exists S in Sep2(C) such that [Col_L(C[S])=empty OR for every sigma in Col_L(C[S]): Closed(C,S,sigma)].

local_escape_only.label: LOCAL_TWO_SEPARATOR_ESCAPE
local_escape_only.formula: exists C, exists S in Sep2(C), exists sigma in Col_L(C[S]): not Closed(C,S,sigma).
local_escape_only.interpretation: This proves only that one separator S is not universally good. It MUST NOT falsify R1 because another S* in the same C may be good.

exact_quantifier_binding.exact_negation_for_one_C: Sep2(C)=empty OR for every S in Sep2(C): [Col_L(C[S]) is nonempty AND exists sigma_S in Col_L(C[S]) such that not Closed(C,S,sigma_S)].
exact_quantifier_binding.empty_boundary_rule: If any S has Col_L(C[S])=empty, GOOD_2(C)=true and strong R2 must fail for that C.

escape_component_definition.label: TWO_SEPARATOR_ESCAPE_COMPONENT
required: exact surviving connected D and exact propagated lists
D has no global missing color
tw(D)>3 with an explicit frozen forbidden-minor model from {K5,OCTAHEDRON,WAGNER_V8,PENTAGONAL_PRISM}
D is not exactly a six-vertex literal octahedron

accepted_certificates: Cut(D)=empty, by complete graph-only articulation enumeration
or complete prior-style negation: for every r in Cut(D), provide kappa_r and a surviving BASE0-escape component after frozen propagation
cut_vertex_composition_rejection.note: A failed heuristic cut search is never sufficient.

R1_TWO_VERTEX_SEPARATOR_COMPOSITION_UNIV.label: R1_TWO_VERTEX_SEPARATOR_COMPOSITION_UNIVERSAL
pass_requires: A theorem/proof-carrying universal argument over the frozen domain; finite corpus success is insufficient.
For every C, graph-only discovery of at least one GOOD_SEP2(C,S).
For every proper boundary state sigma of the selected S, exact frozen propagation and closure of every surviving component by the frozen closure library.
Exact SAT reconstruction and UNSAT aggregation over boundary states.
Polynomial accounting: O(n^2) separator candidates, <=16 states each, polynomial propagation/decomposition, and only authorized polynomial terminal calls.
R1_TWO_VERTEX_SEPARATOR_COMPOSITION_UNIV.consequence_ceiling: The current authoritative residual family is polynomially resolved through a graph-discoverable separator of size at most two and the frozen closure library.

R2_TWO_VERTEX_SEPARATOR_COMPOSITION_ESCA.label: R2_TWO_VERTEX_SEPARATOR_COMPOSITION_ESCAPE

PATH_A.condition: Sep2(C)=empty for one authoritative C in domain.
receipt: complete graph-only Sep2(C) enumeration showing empty
complete domain certificate showing C survives the one-vertex closure library
PATH_A.connectivity_note: If independent audit also verifies Cut(C)=empty and |V(C)|>=4, record only the standard conclusion that C is 3-connected. Sep2(C)=empty alone is the R2 certificate; the 3-connected label requires the separate cut-vertex check.

PATH_B.condition: Sep2(C) is nonempty and every separator S is defeated by at least one proper list-respecting boundary state sigma_S.
receipt: for every S, nonempty Col_L(C[S]) receipt
for every S, one exact proper list-respecting defeating sigma_S
for every S, exact frozen propagation transcript
for every S, at least one exact TWO_SEPARATOR_ESCAPE_COMPONENT D_{S,sigma_S}
for every D, proof-carrying rejection of all current closure terminals
independent replay of separator-set completeness and every defeating branch

R2_TWO_VERTEX_SEPARATOR_COMPOSITION_ESCA.exact_claim: There exists an authoritative residual C with GOOD_2(C)=false.
R2_TWO_VERTEX_SEPARATOR_COMPOSITION_ESCA.scientific_ceiling: One- and two-vertex separator composition, relative to the current frozen closure library, are not universal for authoritative C11 PI residuals.

R3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.label: R3_GATE_UNRESOLVED
R3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.condition: Neither theorem-level R1 nor complete strong-R2 certificate is established.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: TWO_SEPARATOR_MIXED_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic residual with two genuine two-vertex separators S1,S2.
required_behavior: S1 has at least one escaping boundary state.
S2 closes every proper boundary state.

mandatory_quantifier_controls.name: NO_TWO_SEPARATOR_CONTROL
mandatory_quantifier_controls.structure: Synthetic connected graph with at least four vertices, Cut(C)=empty and Sep2(C)=empty, with mocked nonterminal closure labels.
required_behavior: standard 3-connected label permitted only because Cut(C)=empty is separately verified

anti_cheat: Do not promote one bad separator to R2.
Do not omit any graph-only two-vertex separator from Sep2(C).
Do not select S or sigma using extension knowledge.
Do not treat an empty boundary-state set as an escape.
Do not call D escaped merely because a heuristic TW3 or cut-composition search fails; require explicit proof-carrying rejection certificates.
Do not classify an exact literal octahedron as escaped.
Finite enumeration alone cannot establish R1.
Do not open separator size 3, backdoor size 2, tw4, repair, or new state language.
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit only exact two-vertex separator composition over the frozen closure library and stop at R1/strong-R2/R3.
